item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore1: Melee: left-click combo, right-click kick, sneak + right-click parry (base damage %s)
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore2: Magic: right-click casts the selected technique, left-click cancels · hold Ability 4: spell wheel (13 techniques)
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore3: Ability 5: melee ↔ magic · schools: Wind (movement, crescent), Ice (control, walls), Yang (light, bridges)
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore4: A pair, worn in the main hand. The off hand rests.
item.hha_arius.solvane.lore4: Hold Ability 4 – Clear Cut: %s resonance, %s–%s damage (full after 1.5 s) · Cooldown %s s
item.hha_arius.solvane.lore5: Release to cut a plane (sneak = horizontal), splits blocks up to hardness %s (at most %s)
hha_arius.wheel.title: Spell wheel
hha_arius.spell.wind_blade.desc: Wind crescent straight ahead (16 blocks), 5 damage, pierces one target · 0.75 s
hha_arius.spell.wind_leap.desc: Leap up and forward; your next fall deals no damage · 2 s
hha_arius.spell.gale.desc: Hold to charge (up to 1.2 s): wind cone 7 blocks, 3 damage, strong knockback, sweeps projectiles away · 4 s
hha_arius.spell.wind_pull.desc: Pull within 10 blocks: draws in items and experience, puts out fire · 2 s
hha_arius.spell.frost_shards.desc: Three ice shards in a fan (14 blocks), 3 damage each, 1.5 s slow · 1 s
hha_arius.spell.ice_wall.desc: Aim and place: 5 × 3 wall of crystal ice, lasts 10 s · 8 s
hha_arius.spell.frost_field.desc: Aim and place: frost circle for 5 s, heavily slows enemies, freezes water · 10 s
hha_arius.spell.ice_armor.desc: Ice shell for 8 s: absorbs 3 hearts of damage, then shatters · 20 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_orb.desc: Hold to charge (up to 1.5 s): orb of light (24 blocks), 4–10 damage, blooms on impact · 1.5 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_shield.desc: Hold (up to 5 s): light shield in front, −60 % damage, costs 8/s plus per hit · 3 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_platform.desc: Aim and place: 3 × 3 light platform, lasts 15 s, up to 3 at once · 1.5 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_bridge.desc: Light bridge up to 16 blocks straight in your view direction, lasts 15 s · 5 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_glide.desc: Glide on a disc of light (up to 8 s, 4/s), steer with your view, sneak to step off · 10 s
hha_arius.client.shake_on: Camera jolt on heavy hits: on
hha_arius.client.shake_off: Camera jolt on heavy hits: off
hha_arius.keys.gauntlets_melee: Melee: left-click strikes · right-click kick · sneak + right-click parry · [%s] magic · [%s] spell wheel
hha_arius.keys.solvane: Solvane: hold [%s] to charge Clear Cut, release to cut (sneak: horizontal)
hha_arius.keys.conflict: Arius: the key %s is bound to "%s" and also to "%s". Rebind one of them under Options → Controls, otherwise the press may not arrive.
hha_arius.keys.unbound: Arius: "%s" is not bound. Bind it under Options → Controls → HHA, otherwise the spell wheel, mode switch or Clear Cut are missing.
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore5: Chain: jab · cross · hook · uppercut (launches) – kick after the hook = spin kick, after the uppercut = axe kick with a frost wave
